title: Trump Vows to Investigate EU Over Big Tech Fines and Regulation
excerpt: Donald Trump pledges to investigate the EU's record fines against US tech giants. This article explores the potential trade war, the billions at stake, and what the escalating conflict means for the future of global technology regulation.
description: Trump pledges to investigate the EU's record fines against US tech giants. Explore the potential trade war and what it means for global tech regulation.
